finding.prior_finding: Date.now rollback could extend the 15-second native health wait; the first implementation also depended on wall-clock progress.
evidence: The current waiter establishes and checks its deadline with monotonicClock, defaulting to performance.now; strict evidence freshness remains based on the injected wall clock.
It refuses when monotonic elapsed time is beyond the deadline before and after the strict health probe, so a late refresh cannot release an action.
The harness wires awaitNativeResourceHealth into both requireResourceHealth and resourceAction; runNativeResourceAction awaits the gate before invoking the action.

node --test tests/browser/native-resource-boundary.test.mjs passes on HEAD, covering own-run fresh health and refusal for stale expiry, wall rollback, post-deadline refresh, unsafe evidence, wrong run, stop, and missing evidence.
A temporary copy with monotonicClock() replaced by clock() fails the rollback case at the explicit wall_clock_extended_wait sentinel; source tree was not changed by the mutation.
finding.remaining_issue: The mutation proof demonstrates over-budget looping but the regression assertion reports the harness sentinel rather than matching stale_health. The production implementation and normal test pass; this is a proof-quality limitation, not an observed source defect.

verdict_a.evidence: The boundary and real native driver wiring were inspected. No hosted/native UI run was performed; source readiness does not establish actual guest acceptance.

verdict_b.forcing_negative: The repaired suite passes; a temporary wall-clock mutant fails on the named over-budget sentinel. Existing test does not produce the ideal stale_health assertion under the mutant.
verdict_b.concern: The single large boundary test combines multiple refusal conditions, and the negative rollback proof's assertion is indirect. No edits were made under this reviewer lane.

checks.driver_wiring: PASS: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs supplies the waiter to requireResourceHealth and resourceAction.
